jobs.title: SIDBI Grade A & B Recruitment 2026: 68 Officer Posts
jobs.summary: Small Industries Development Bank of India has notified 68 officer posts: 63 Assistant Manager (Grade A) and 5 Manager (Grade B). Apply online by 11 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Grade A General - graduation in Commerce/Economics/Maths/Statistics/Business Admin/Engineering with 60% (50% SC/ST/PwBD), or CA/CS/CMA/CFA, or full-time 2-year MBA/PGDM; experience rules as per notification
Age: Grade A 21-30, Grade B 25-33 years as on 21-11-2026
Pay: Grade A basic Rs 62,500 (gross approx Rs 1,20,000/month); Grade B basic Rs 78,450
Fee: General/OBC/EWS Rs 1,100; SC/ST/PwBD Rs 175
Selection: Phase I online test, Phase II descriptive and stream papers, Phase III interview
Dates: apply 21 Nov - 11 Dec 2026; exam tentatively 27 Dec 2026

jobs.title: ISRO SAC Ahmedabad Apprentice 2026: Graduate, Technician & Trade Apprentices
jobs.summary: ISRO's Space Applications Centre, Ahmedabad has notified graduate, technician and trade apprenticeships for 2026-27 (26 post codes). Apply online by 2 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech, B.Com, BCA or BA with 60%, diploma (first class) or ITI; passed Dec 2023 or later; degree/diploma from MH, GJ, Goa, CG, MP, RJ or DNH&DD (ITI from Gujarat)
Age: Graduate 18-28, others 18-35 years as on 02-12-2026
Stipend: Graduate Rs 12,300; Technician Rs 10,900; Trade Rs 10,560-11,040 per month
Selection: shortlisting on qualifying-exam marks, document verification
Dates: apply 11 Nov - 2 Dec 2026

jobs.title: IOCL Eastern Region Apprentice 2026: 70 Graduate Apprentice Seats
jobs.summary: Indian Oil's Marketing Division, Eastern Region has notified graduate, technician, trade and DEO apprenticeships, including 70 graduate seats. Apply by 12 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: full-time BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA with 50% (45% reserved); B.E./B.Tech, MBA and CA holders not eligible for graduate trade
Age: 18-24 years as on 30-11-2026
Stipend: as per Apprentices Act
Selection: merit on qualifying-exam marks, document verification, medical
Dates: apply 13 Nov - 12 Dec 2026 (NATS for graduates)

jobs.title: SJVN Apprentice 2026: 100 Graduate, Diploma & ITI Seats
jobs.summary: SJVN Limited has notified 100 apprenticeship seats (40 graduate, 25 diploma, 35 ITI) for Himachal Pradesh domicile candidates. Apply online by 17 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E. (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/IT), diploma or ITI in the trade; Himachal Pradesh domicile
Age: 18-30 years as on 17-12-2026
Stipend: Graduate Rs 15,000; Diploma Rs 13,500; ITI Rs 12,500 per month
Fee: Rs 100; SC/ST/EWS/PwBD exempt
Selection: merit on weighted marks, no interview
Dates: apply 18 Nov - 17 Dec 2026
